audit_result.proof_trace: The property requires all port-3000 handlers to pass `authMiddleware`, but `GET /health` (L38-65) is intentionally registered without it. This exposes the Discord guild ID, bot user tag, and WS connection status to unauthenticated callers, and triggers a live Discord API call (`client.guilds.fetch`) on every request. All `/api/*` routes (L68-77) correctly apply `authMiddleware`; the sole violation is the intentional health-check bypass.
audit_result.attack_scenario: An unauthenticated external attacker can call `GET /health` to enumerate the Discord guild ID and bot identity for reconnaissance, and can repeatedly invoke the endpoint to trigger Discord API calls against the bot's token, potentially exhausting its rate limit.

PROP-docker-compo-pre-001.text: All HTTP requests on port 3000 must pass through bearer token authentication before reaching route handlers.
PROP-docker-compo-pre-001.assertion: forall req on port 3000: handler(req) => req.passed_auth_middleware == true
